Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.13819

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2025).
source_name: Basile Coron, Luis Ferroni and Shiyue Li, “Chow polynomials of rank-uniform labeled posets”, arXiv:2511.13819 (2025).
statement: Let $\mathrm{M}$ be a matroid, and let its Chow polynomial be the polynomial invariant associated with its lattice of flats. **Ferroni–Schröter's conjecture.** The Chow polynomial of $\mathrm{M}$ has only nonpositive real roots. This is a central real-rootedness question for matroid invariants; the source presents it as a motivating conjecture, without stating a resolution.
title: Ferroni–Schröter's real-rootedness conjecture for Chow polynomials
